texts: On day 17 of Year 1, the keepers on the Cliff Path added salt-bloom to the mire-essence of their lanterns at sundown.
The mire-essence in the lanterns burned slowly.
The cold wind struck the Cliff Path again that night.
No lantern on the Cliff Path went out that night.
The cold snap ended after three nights.
The Council continued to distribute salt-bloom throughout the rest of the autumn.

q1_issues.issue: (Inheritance cold_snap cold) exposes the modifier as the compound's genus while omitting the head-noun genus (snap), which the compound-kind rule says is always emitted; the modifier genus is only ever an addition to the head genus, never a substitute for it.

(Ongoing sk_distribute_1) puts a status atom on a non-finite control complement, which the control-verb pattern says carries no tense/status of its own, and "continued to V" is not one of the four enumerated Ongoing markers (progressive morphology, continuative perfect, inceptive complement, perception participle).

"No lantern on the Cliff Path" is ranged over (PartOf $x sk_lanterns_1) — the keepers' lantern group from sentence 1 — instead of the restricted kind (Member $x lantern) plus the restriction as a premise conjunct, narrowing the blanket denial to one previously-introduced set.

(On sk_lanterns_1 cliff_path) asserts that the keepers' lantern group is on the Cliff Path; the text attaches "on the Cliff Path" to the keepers and to the quantified "no lantern", never to those lanterns as a group.

q2_gaps: A continuative aspectual verb ("continued to V") is not covered: the instruction set gives Inception (began/started to V) and cessation (no longer / used to) but no form for continuation of an ongoing activity.

"ended after three nights" — a relative-offset temporal adjunct with an unnamed anchor has no licensed form; the parse re-reads it as the eventuality's own duration Measure, which states a total extent the sentence gives only relative to an implicit start.
review.notes: go_out kept whole with no genus, the cold/wind split into two Member atoms, the capitalized-common-noun Council with no Name atom, the RestOf partitive and throughout->During are all exactly per doctrine. The per-member add rule beside the group event and the paired strength-0 denial plus rule for "no lantern" follow the plural-distribution and negated-group patterns.

issues.reason: Compound concepts states the head genus "is always emitted either way" and makes the modifier genus an addition to it rather than a substitute, and the IS-A suppression escape does not apply because "snap" independently denotes a brief spell of weather, so the missing (Inheritance cold_snap snap) is a real omission of a mandated atom.

A continuative aspectual matrix verb is genuinely uncovered (the reviewer's own gap), and the Inception template — reify the aspectual verb, Theme = the activity's own witness marked Ongoing — is the nearest licensed analogue, so (Ongoing sk_distribute_1) is true of "continued to distribute" and well-typed, which the calibration line makes acceptable improvisation rather than a defect; "continue" is an aspectual verb like "begin", not one of the volitional control verbs the no-status rule lists.

"No lantern on the Cliff Path" names a restricted kind, so the negative-universal rule must range over (Member $x lantern) with the restriction as a premise conjunct (the adjectivally-restricted-kind-subject rule); ranging over (PartOf $x sk_lanterns_1) silently swaps the stated restriction for membership in a previously-introduced set — barred by Core patterns' "a stated restriction is never silently dropped" — and leaves the (QuantifierPhrase lantern go_out "no") companion naming a range the rule does not quantify.

The text states "on the Cliff Path" of the keepers and inside the quantified "no lantern" NP, never of the keepers' lanterns as a group, so the strength-1.0 (On sk_lanterns_1 cliff_path) asserts an unstated location, which Core patterns bars ("no unstated property, possessor, location or causal link, however obvious").

gaps_confirmed: No form for a continuative aspectual matrix verb ("continued to V"): Inception and cessation each get an explicit template, continuation of an ongoing activity gets none, and the nearest carriers (Still, and the inceptive's Ongoing) are each defined for other constructions.

A relative-offset temporal adjunct with an unnamed anchor ("ended after three nights") has no licensed form — BeforeBy needs two eventualities, and only deictic "ago / from now" gets the reserved now anchor — so the extent can only be re-read as the eventuality's own duration Measure.
new_gaps: QuantifierPhrase has no slot for a restricted range: when the rule ranges over a restricted kind ("no lantern on the Cliff Path"), the companion (QuantifierPhrase lantern go_out "no") can only name the bare kind, which is broader than the range the rule actually quantifies — the instruction set requires the companion to restate exactly the rule's range.
adjudication.defect_summary: cold_snap must carry its head genus (Inheritance cold_snap snap) beside the modifier genus; "No lantern on the Cliff Path went out that night" must be a single strength-0.0 rule ranging over (And (Member $x lantern) (On $x cliff_path)) with no group-level denial over the keepers' lantern group; and (On sk_lanterns_1 cliff_path) must simply not be emitted, the restriction living only as that rule's premise conjunct.
adjudication.notes: The Ongoing atom is the one issue I refute — "continued to V" is genuinely uncovered and the inceptive template is the closest licensed analogue. The three confirmed issues after the genus omission share one root: the quantified "no lantern on the Cliff Path" was resolved to the keepers' lantern group from sentence 1 instead of being treated as a restricted kind.
